Hi Alex / Redwood team,

We spotted your listing on the cloud marketplace and kicked off a trial this morning — thanks for the easy signup flow. We have a small team evaluating inference costs and latency for a feature we plan to ship Q1.

Would love a brief intro and demo to see:
- how Reserved vs Hosted flows differ for hybrid setups

Hi Liam — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the marketplace onboarding was smooth. I'm Alex Martinez, Account Executive on the Cloud Marketplace book. Jasmine (cc) is our SDR who helps get the right folks scheduled and collects useful context ahead of demos.

Quick questions before we lock a time so we tailor the session:
- Who from your side will attend (engineering, product, procurement)?
- Are you most interested in hosted vs private deployment, or evaluating both?
- Any specific sample prompts/sequence lengths we should run live?

I have 30-minute slots available tomorrow 11/19 at: 10:30am ET, 2:00pm ET, or 4:30pm ET. If none of those work, propose a time that suits your team and we’ll accommodate. We'll run a short demo + Q&A and I can share a quick cost estimate against the usage you attached.

If useful, I can also send a calendar invite with an agenda and a short checklist for the trial so our demo is actionable.

Thanks —
